about: HELD-OUT recall set for parse-time person redaction (F-HONEST OSINT-2). Written BEFORE the cue-less, Indic-script and social age-marker patterns of FIX-G-OSINT, and never edited to fit them: a case the redactor misses stays in the set and lowers the reported recall. Real-shaped Ahmedabad headlines and posts; every person in them is invented (common given names and surnames, no public figure). 'names': the words of each person name, which must not survive redaction; 'ages': age or age/sex markers, which must not survive; 'keep': place or ordinary words that must survive (precision guard). Scored by tests/test_heldout_recall.py.
